source.title: Call for Applicants - WDPC Leader (January 2019)
source.content:
The successful passing of the [WCA Data Protection Policy v1.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/Data%20Protection.pdf) established the **WCA Data Protection Committee (WDPC)** that is in need of a leader. The WCA Data Protection Committee is an Advisory Committee of the WCA which is responsible for all matters relating to Data Protection including, but not limited to the EU General Data Protection Regulations (GDPR) and other Data Protection and Privacy regulations worldwide.

The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered. Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 7 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:
- Strong leadership skills
- Good knowledge of Data Protection and GDPR
- Attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until **February 5th, 2019, 23:59 UTC** privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).

**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**
1. Brief personal introduction.
2. Summary of activities done for the WCA.
3. Ambitions as the WDPC Leader.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WDPC are can be found in the [WCA Data Protection Policy v1.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/Data%20Protection.pdf).

Following the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: WCA 数据保护委员会招募负责人（2019 年 1 月）
translation.content:
随着 [WCA 数据保护政策 v1.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/Data%20Protection.pdf) 获得通过，**WCA 数据保护委员会（WDPC）**正式成立，现需招募一位负责人。WDPC 是 WCA 的顾问委员会，负责所有与数据保护有关的事务，包括但不限于欧盟《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR），以及世界各地其他数据保护和隐私法规。

所有人均可申请，无需目前在 WCA 任职。申请人应能完成 24 个月任期，并平均每周至少投入 7 小时处理委员会事务。我们希望申请人具备：

- 出色的领导能力。
- 熟悉数据保护及 GDPR。
- 注重细节。
- 出色的沟通能力。

申请现已开放，请于 **2019 年 2 月 5 日 23:59 UTC** 前，私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：**

1. 简短的个人介绍。
2. 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
3. 担任 WDPC 负责人的工作设想。

另请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WDPC 的权利与职责见 [WCA 数据保护政策 v1.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/Data%20Protection.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将通过投票选出新负责人，并按照 [WCA 议案 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) 第 4 节，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
